entries.subject: DAMIT 4172: selected shape and spin
entries.finding: The official DAMIT metadata export was joined by model and asteroid identity and compared with the selected local recipe shape/model-4172.txt. Model 4172, version 2019-05-07, pole (307°, -26°), period 14.73572 h match the retained metadata. The archive supplies no diameter for this model; a separate scale constraint is required. This comparison checks source identity and metadata, not fresh mesh bytes, registration or the completeness of other archives.

entries.subject: NEOWISE Gr12b: selected thermal size
entries.finding: The original IRSA query was rerun for asteroid 5130; its Gr12b row matches the retained diameter 60.7110 km, error 0.9820 km, fit code DVBI and mean epoch 2455361.7542230. D in FIT_CODE means diameter was fitted. This effective-sphere diameter provides an approximate display scale, not a resolved surface or an independent physical-volume fit to the shape.

entries.subject: Source mesh and calibration preservation
entries.finding: The [original mesh](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/stored_files/open/13030/shape.txt) is retained without changing its coordinates or connectivity. [DAMIT documentation](https://damit.cuni.cz/projects/damit/pages/documentation) supplies the coordinate units, pole and sidereal-period conventions; its CC BY 4.0 terms and other credits are linked from NOTICE.md.

entries.subject: Hanuš 2023: consistency with the existing DAMIT solution
entries.finding: The existing-DAMIT table was checked: (307°, −26°), 14.7357 h, agreeing with the selected archive solution to the paper’s printed precision. Included as a source consistency check, not a newly adopted mesh or surface qualification.
